2610.13479.title: A Local Agentic AI Framework to Generate Edge Case Scenarios for Safety Assurance
2610.13479.paper_summary: Generating edge case scenarios is crucial for training, testing and safety assuring autonomous systems. This identifies hazardous failures to increase system reliability and robustness, ensures the system can still function safely on the boundaries of its operational design domain and learns the expected system behaviour for these edge cases. The rapid advancement in the generation and analysis capabilities of language models (LMs) has expanded their applicability and recent work has investigated LM scenario generation. However, many recent approaches rely on human-in-the-loop or rule-based strategies. This restricts the LM's ability to generate diverse and edge case scenarios; the long tail of the distribution. Our work uses local LMs in a laptop-based agentic AI framework for adaptive scenario generation. This is cheap, fully-controlled, ensures data privacy and security. It uses think, act, observe, update, and continue loops with lightweight JSON encoding to generate scenarios. We use the system requirements, system description and environment description as knowledge bases in contextual prompts for an LM to ensure scenario realism. A second, independent LM critiques each scenario using domain specific criteria so it can be refined. The refined scenarios are run in simulation and evaluation metrics collected. These metric scores are analysed and similar scenarios are created for edge cases (exploitation) or novel scenarios are generated to explore the scenario space. Post-hoc clustering using metric scores and thematic-type analysis of the rich-text scenario descriptions produced by the LM pinpoints functional gaps and their triggering conditions. This creates traceable evidence for the safety assurance case. Our work highlights the potential of a flexible and adaptive local agentic AI framework for automating edge case generation and producing traceable safety assurance evidence.
2610.13479.paper_summary_zh: 生成邊緣案例場景對於訓練、測試和安全保證自主系統至關重要。這有助於識別危險失敗，以提高系統的可靠性和穩健性，確保系統在其操作設計範圍的邊界上仍能安全運行，並學習這些邊緣案例的預期系統行為。語言模型（LM）生成和分析能力的快速進步擴大了它們的適用性，最近的工作已經研究了LM場景生成。然而，許多近期的方法依賴於人類介入或基於規則的策略。這限制了LM生成多樣化和邊緣案例場景的能力；即分佈的長尾。我們的工作在基於筆記本電腦的代理AI框架中使用本地LM進行自適應場景生成。這是便宜的、完全可控的，確保數據隱私和安全。它使用思考、行動、觀察、更新和繼續循環，搭配輕量級JSON編碼來生成場景。我們使用系統需求、系統描述和環境描述作為知識庫，在上下文提示中提供給LM，以確保場景的現實性。第二個獨立的LM使用特定領域的標準對每個場景進行評析，以便進行精煉。經過精煉的場景在模擬中運行並收集評估指標。這些指標分數被分析，並為邊緣案例（利用）創建相似的場景，或生成新場景以探索場景空間。使用指標分數的後期聚類和LM生成的豐富文本場景描述的主題類型分析，指出功能缺口及其觸發條件。這為安全保證案例創造了可追溯的證據。我們的工作突顯了靈活且自適應的本地代理AI框架在自動化邊緣案例生成和產生可追溯的安全保證證據方面的潛力。
